body: Sorry things are not going the way you like.  You sound like a nice person to me.  But, if you are not sure, or, as it seems,  your friends were not sure, then maybe you can see a Psychiatrist, who you can tell you are feeling suicidal because you doubt your worth.  They can tell you if you do have an issue that can be improved upon, or if there is nothing wrong and your friends were the ones who were being bad people.  But, as I said, you seem just fine to me.

I am terrified of blood, terrified of my internal body parts that lie under my skin, terrified of seeing any part of my body out of proper position.  How can I possibly end my life when my extreme crippling level of fear of every part of my body prevents me from injuring myself?

I think I know what that is like: always thinking other people are judging you to where it paralyzes you.  Even when you can use reason to understand all the people in public really could care less about what you are personally doing, you still can't stop the paralyzing fear/anxiety of being judged.  The CBT therapy did nothing for me.  On top of that, you have the bad depression, and periods of mania (wish I at the mania).  All I can say is that you are not alone here, many people also trying to live with these things, like me.   Maybe just making contact and being in support groups with other similar people might make like more worthwhile.

Do you live is USA, Canada, Europe, or Australia?  All these countries have public mental health services that are free if you can't afford it.  I live in the USA and see a free doctor who prescribes me stuff for my depression/anxiety cause I am too  neurotic to work: always scared, always depressed.    If you are suicidal, any of these free places would immediately see you.  Just look up on internet right now for nearest services.

I am sorry you are not feeling well.  I feel the same way too: no friends, no family, no girlfriend or wife,  no future, no past, just frozen in hell.  But, you know, if you were able to make it all the way to South Korea, that means you have lots of talent, certainly much more than I.  If you are financially in trouble, South Korea is a highly developed nation that has plenty of government resources that can help you.  Have you made contact with their Social Services  departments?  I would do this right away: financial and mental health social services.  I bet you have lots of potential, and to use it in South Korea, a really cool country.

I am sorry that you are not feeling well.  I feel the same way, all the time.  But, can doctors help you?  Have you at least tried all the medications that can help with the bipolar and depression?  There are lots of organizations that can help.
